description: Eight attenuverters, each with its own input and output

params.text: Sets the gain of that row from -1 to +1: silent in the middle of its travel, passing the input unchanged at the far right, and flipping its polarity at the far left

inputs.text: The signal into that row; with nothing patched, the row takes the row above it, and the top row takes a fixed 10V

outputs.text: That row's signal after its attenuverter
